title: test_data_manifest
description: Output of test-data-identification. Each record is one test_data_output object — the same shape written into the enriched plan at automation_scenarios[].test_data[].test_data_output[], a sibling of required_state rather than nested under an 'output' wrapper.

manifest_version.description: v1, v2, ... bumped on every re-identification run.

source_plan_version.description: plan_version of the automation_plan.json this manifest was identified from.

identified_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the identification run.

records.description: One record per (scenario_id, fixture_id) that resolved to a Test Data Domain.

unidentified_fixtures.description: Fixtures with no usable identification — no TDP category and no supported operation, or the domain itself could not be resolved. No test_data_output is written to the plan for these.

missing_operations.description: Operations the required_state needs that get_supported_operations does not expose. Actionable backlog for the TDP team.

needs_human_review.description: fixture_ids with match_confidence low, or with an unsupported operation — SDET reviews before test-data-provision runs.

run_log.description: Debug trail for the whole run, emitted as run_log.json. Deliberately NOT part of test_data_output: the enriched plan is a provisioning contract, and a per-record audit would duplicate across every scenario sharing a fixture. Entries are ordered; fixture_id scopes the per-fixture steps, absent for run-level setup.

fixture_id.description: Which fixture this step belongs to. Omit for run-level setup steps (knowledge load, catalog reads).

action.description: read_knowledge | extract_signals | get_supported_category | validate_gate | get_supported_operation | resolve_status | generate_prompt | read_operation_catalog

scenario_id.description: Same scenario_id as in the automation_plan.json method that uses this fixture.

fixture_id.description: Same fixture_id as in automation_plan.json fixtures_summary[].

test_data_domain.description: Test Data Domain resolved from fixture details + references/test_data_domains.md. Open vocabulary owned by the TDP team, e.g. CUSTOMER, DRIVER, MERCHANT, PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT, VOUCHER, WALLET_BALANCE, BOOKING, LOCATION.

test_data_type_signals.description: Atomic state signals lifted from the fixture description + required_state. One signal per concept, e.g. ["Bike", "4w", "SDF", "Polygon", "non jabo"].

test_data_status.description: TDP_SUPPORTED = fully served by a TDP category. TESTBUDDY_SUPPORTED = served by a TestBuddy agent tool rather than a TDP pool category. TDP_HYBRID_FALLBACK = partial support in TDP/TestBuddy plus supported operations (via MCP: Pertamax/GBT). TDP_OPERATION_FALLBACK = no TDP category, but supported operations can build the state. TDP_NOT_SUPPORTED = no category and at least one required operation unsupported (formerly TDP_COMPLETE_FALLBACK).

tdp_test_data_category.description: Exact category name returned by get_supported_categories. null when no category matches (TDP_OPERATION_FALLBACK). Never invented.

test_data_operations.description: Ordered operation sequence that closes the gap between the category and required_state. null when the category alone satisfies the fixture. [] when the gap needs an operation TDP/TestBuddy does not support (TDP_COMPLETE_FALLBACK) — the missing names go to unidentified_fixtures[].missing_operations.

operationSource.description: Which system exposes this operation, and therefore which client provisioning calls. Only TestBuddy and Pertamax MCP servers are callable today; a 'gbt' source is planned for a later stage and must not be emitted until that server exists.

operationMcpTool.description: Exact MCP tool/feature name that performs it, e.g. CustomerAgent_recharge_customer_gopay or handle_set_gopay_pin. null when unresolved.

operationMcpToolDescription.description: The tool's own description, carried through so provisioning and reviewers can see its contract without re-querying.

count.description: Number of entities to fetch/create. From required_state.count, default 1.

tdp_request.description: TDP_Request returned by TestDataAgent_get_supported_category for the resolved category, carried through verbatim. null when the category was rejected by the validation gate. Provisioning prefers this structured request over the prose test_buddy_prompt.

test_buddy_prompt.description: Prompt TestBuddy can execute to produce this data. Generated via the generate_testBuddy_prompt MCP tool. null for TDP_COMPLETE_FALLBACK.

match_confidence.description: Confidence of the domain + category semantic match. low routes the fixture to human review before provisioning.

identification_steps.description: Ordered account of what the agent did to identify THIS fixture — one short sentence per action, in the order taken (knowledge read, signals extracted, category returned, gate decision, each operation resolved, status concluded, prompt generated or skipped). Reviewer-facing: a wrong category or missing operation should be explainable from this list alone.
